prompt:
Production game inventory icon atlas on a perfectly SQUARE fully transparent canvas. Invisible exact 4 by 4 grid of equal square cells, exactly sixteen separate Chinese wuxia inventory icons. Important: SMALL ICONS, each entire object must fit within central 55 percent of its cell width and height. At least 22 percent transparent margin on all four sides of every cell. Icon centers exactly at 12.5,37.5,62.5,87.5 percent canvas coordinates. Wide completely EMPTY transparent gutters on all three horizontal and three vertical dividing lines. No touching or overlap between objects. Preserve full silhouette including cords and long handles. Hand-painted gouache/watercolor, fine warm-brown outlines, muted slate blue, cream and mist grey Wudang palette, soft top-left lighting. No people, no text or pseudo-writing, no letters, no numerals, no labels, no visible grid, no frames, no background scenery, no glow. Book cover marks are only simple abstract geometric motifs. Exact row-major left-to-right top-to-bottom contents:
1. Slate-blue stitched sword primer, cream pine sprig emblem, narrow silver-grey cloth bookmark.
2. Fan-open pale grey folding diagram with slate-blue arcs and fine sword-tip marks, small jade-toned clasp.
3. Long blue-grey silk-backed scroll, round stone and split-wave emblem, ivory-jade roller ends.
4. Narrow cream booklet sleeve with slate-blue spine and a small tied tassel of soft white fibers.
5. Cream rounded softcover breathing booklet, pale blue dotted rings, slender blue-grey wrap band.
6. Celadon hard-cover manual with slender wooden channel motif, staggered cream page tabs.
7. Deep slate-blue cloth case holding two slim cream volumes, open silver-grey ring emblems.
8. Long folded cream route diagram, pale blue stair marks, one flat round wooden bead tied at the end.
9. Small six-fold blue-grey fan booklet, pine-branch silhouettes linked by footprints, white cord at base.
10. Two-column loose study sheets in a pale stone-textured folder, slate-blue short cord and pierced bamboo disc.
11. Slim silver-grey straight sword, open-ring guard, slate-blue wrapped grip, short cream tassel.
12. Pale wooden-handled horsetail whisk, naturally falling cream fibers, slate-blue cord knot at handle end.
13. Folded blue-grey short cloak, cream cloud-pattern edging, visible sleeve ties, plain wooden toggle.
14. Two semicircular bamboo tokens forming an open ring, slate-blue thread through holes, empty center.
15. Three short grey-blue incense sticks in a cream paper tube, pine-leaf seal, blue cord with a small tag.
16. Aged cream promise scroll with blue-grey silk tie, tiny old pinewood fragment and two faded seal marks.
Use equal visual weight, NO oversized objects. Paired pieces stay inside their one cell. Exactly sixteen items, no additions, no duplicates, no omissions.
visual_review: Thumbnail semantic audit: 16 icons retain row-major order. WD001 sword cover; WD002 rectangular open sword/yin-yang manual, no fan; WD003 fist/yin-yang scroll; WD004 palm; WD005 breathing; WD006 meridians/sun; WD007 yin-yang/meridians; WD009 ascending footsteps. Remaining identities retained. A second edit reduced icon scale and widened gutters. Generated output visually checked; transparent RGBA verified with zero alpha>32 pixels at all equal-grid boundaries and outer edges. Per-item observations are recorded in thumbnail audit report.
revision_prompt:
Edit the supplied 4x4 Wudang inventory atlas. Every martial manual must immediately communicate its martial TYPE. Keep exactly sixteen items in their row-major cells, square RGBA transparent canvas, blue grey cream watercolor game-icon style. Preserve identities of cells 8,10,11,12,13,14,15,16. Change ONLY these eight cells:
CELL1 row1 col1: slate-blue RECTANGULAR stitched sword manual, LARGE clear straight Chinese jian sword DIAGRAM on its cover. Replace the pine-only image with the sword.
CELL2 row1 col2: completely REMOVE the fan. Replace with an OPEN RECTANGULAR PAPER BOOK, its LEFT PAGE clearly showing ONE straight Chinese jian sword drawing from tip to hilt; RIGHT PAGE a large yin-yang circle and a simple circular motion arrow. This is the Tai Chi SWORD MANUAL, NOT a fan, not a loose weapon, not fan-shaped pages. Both pages rectangular.
CELL3 row1 col3: cream rectangular vertical scroll, clearly printed FIST silhouette, yin-yang symbol and soft circular movement arrows. Tai Chi boxing scroll, no water-only abstract image.
CELL4 row1 col4: cream RECTANGULAR stitched PALM TECHNIQUE MANUAL, cover prominently showing one OPEN PALM silhouette with smooth flowing arcs around the fingers. Remove long case and fluffy tassel identity.
CELL5 row2 col1: cream RECTANGULAR inner-energy booklet with a clear seated meditation outline and concentric breathing rings around lower belly, not arbitrary circles.
CELL6 row2 col2: celadon rectangular inner-energy book, clear simplified TORSO MERIDIAN diagram with central spinal line/dots, plus a small radiating sun emblem above; replace the wooden-channel illustration.
CELL7 row2 col3: open slate-blue rectangular inner-energy scripture, on its pages large YIN-YANG diagram and simplified connected MERIDIAN points, unobstructed by cases or bundles. Do not leave two closed spines.
CELL9 row3 col1: replace fan-like folded paper with a RECTANGULAR open footwork booklet, displaying a rising stair-step route with FOOTPRINTS and a single upward jumping arc; no pine-only motif, no fan silhouette.
Every book and diagram is distinct, legible at thumbnail size using bold simple pictograms. Printed anatomical diagram pictograms are allowed, but no separate people or hands. Keep correct cell8's stair-footprint route, cell10's sword practice papers, actual sword, whisk, long Taoist robe, bamboo token, incense and seven-station formation scroll. Keep all objects smaller than 72% of their equal cell width and height, centered at 12.5/37.5/62.5/87.5 percent coordinates, ample transparent gutters, no clipping or cross-cell overlap. NO readable text or pseudo-calligraphy, no letters, numbers, labels, gridlines, borders or scenery. Transparent background.
